en.hubeali: A number of our companions, from Sahl Bin Ziyad, from Ibn Abu Najran, from Aasim Bin Humeyd, from Abu Sahl Al Qurshy who said,

‘I asked Abu Abdullah<sup>asws</sup> about meat of the dog. So he<sup>asws</sup> said: ‘It is a morphed (creature)’. I said, ‘It is Prohibited?’ He<sup>asws</sup> said: ‘It is unclean’. I re-iterated over it three times, during each of that he<sup>asws</sup> was saying: ‘It is unclean’.
en.sarwar: 6. A number of our people have narrated from Sahl ibn Ziyad from ibn abu Najran from ‘Asem ibn Hamid from abu Sahl al-Qarashiy who has said the following: “

I once asked abu ‘Abd Allah, ‘Alayhi al-Salam, about the flesh of dogs. He (the Imam) said, ‘It is metamorphosed.’ I asked, ‘Is it unlawful for food?’ He (the Imam) said, ‘It is Najis (unclean). I repeat it three times for you and each one says it is Najis (unclean).”’
